quotes.text: Accept wallets and all local cards in South Korea without a local entity.
More descriptive decline codes give you better insight into why payment wasn't completed. If you're interested in this preview feature, provide your email address below.
After the payment is approved, funds are available in your Stripe account after 4 days.

If you offer subscriptions to South Korean customers, you must notify your customers and obtain their consent at least 30 days before any price increase or before charging for a previously free service.

old_evidence.text: After the payment is approved, funds are available in your Stripe account after 4 days.
Customers have up to 365 calendar days from the date of purchase to file a dispute.

If you offer subscriptions to South Korean customers, you must notify your customers and obtain their consent at least 30 days before any price increase or before charging for a previously free service.

findings: Both captures describe Stripe plus a local processor partner serving South Korean customers without requiring a local South Korean entity; a checkout Pay click redirects to a method provider or processor for customer authorization and does not itself complete payment. KRW presentment, 28 listed merchant countries, no Singapore Kakao Pay, and local legal/tax compliance caution remain. New raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:7-17,33-58,98-129,150-164; old raw/stripe-korea-payment-methods-2025.md:6-17,21-46,86-117,138-152; current wiki/sources/source-stripe-korea-payment-methods.md:13-25.

Only material November raw addition is an optional early-access preview for more descriptive South Korean decline codes, with a registration example requiring an email and preview identifier. This is interest/registration, not enablement, provisioned access, or an actually returned decline code (raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:19-29; diff tracking/collections/stripe/recollection-2026-11-07-en/pages/3cad5616010fd1013c7d2204/content.diff:13-24). The command is evidence text, not an instruction to execute.

Both versions distinguish customer authentication from approval, funds becoming available in Stripe balance four days after approval (raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:152; raw/stripe-korea-payment-methods-2025.md:140), and payout schedule T+4 for US or T+7 outside US (raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:72-76; raw/stripe-korea-payment-methods-2025.md:60-64). Current wiki/sources/source-stripe-korea-payment-methods.md:18-19 states both, but a reader should not collapse funds availability into external payout.

Per-method matrix is unchanged: all local cards, Kakao Pay and Naver Pay support one-time and recurring; Samsung Pay and PAYCO only one-time (raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:154-164; raw/stripe-korea-payment-methods-2025.md:142-152). Generic property Recurring: Yes (raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:68-70) applies to the bundle, not every method. Connect and manual capture yes, partial capture no (raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:78-96; raw/stripe-korea-payment-methods-2025.md:66-84).

Installments are issuer-customer arrangements on local card purchases at least 50,000 KRW; Stripe text says the merchant receives the purchase amount upfront relative to the installments, which does not override the four-day post-approval funds-available boundary or actual payout schedule (raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:166-170,152,72-76; raw/stripe-korea-payment-methods-2025.md:154-158,140).

Refund submission for South Korean methods is limited to 365 calendar days from original charge; the page also states general local consumer refund rights with used/damaged and mismatch conditions, plus unused-subscription and prorated cancellation qualifiers. Dispute filing 365 days, response seven days, decision within 45 days after evidence, final outcome, and seven reason codes are unchanged (raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:172-204; raw/stripe-korea-payment-methods-2025.md:160-193). Current wiki/sources/source-stripe-korea-payment-methods.md:27-28 compresses this.

Both dated captures require businesses to notify customers AND obtain their consent at least 30 days before any subscription price increase or charging for a previously free service, plus a reminder seven days before actual payment (new raw lines 206-208; old raw lines 195-197). Existing source-stripe-korea-payment-methods.md line 30 and concept wiki/concepts/stripe-korea-payment-methods.md lines 48-49 mention notice and reminder but omit the customer-consent obligation; this is an unchanged baseline omission, separate from the November preview. Easy cancellation is advice to reduce disputes (new raw line 210; old raw line 199), while a checkout checkbox is illustrative best practice (new raw lines 212-214).

Existing summary accuracy is mostly sound for method availability and numeric timing (wiki/sources/source-stripe-korea-payment-methods.md:13-30); baseline precision issues are wiki/sources/source-stripe-korea-payment-methods.md:17 'not MoR' as an inference from local-processor wording rather than an explicit legal role designation, wiki/sources/source-stripe-korea-payment-methods.md:28 'Korean consumer law mandates' broader than raw's 'generally entitled' with exceptions, and wiki/sources/source-stripe-korea-payment-methods.md:29 'merchant gets full amount upfront' without four-day/payout qualification. These are not November semantic changes.

Both dated guides direct businesses using Stripe front-end products to enable South Korean payment methods in Dashboard before Stripe automatically selects relevant methods (new raw lines 131-148; old raw lines 119-136). The mapped source source-stripe-korea-payment-methods.md lines 13-30 omits Dashboard enablement. Preview decline-code registration at new raw lines 19-29 is separate and does not enable the payment methods; method display, customer redirect, authorization and approved payment are different stages.
substantive_changes: Optional early-access interest form and registration request for descriptive South Korean decline codes (raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:19-29), absent from raw/stripe-korea-payment-methods-2025.md:14-19. This adds a preview path only; availability and response format are not documented here.
historical_claims_to_preserve: May 8 2026 capture's 28-location, KRW, per-method one-time/recurring and Kakao Pay Singapore exception claims remain corroborated unchanged in November (raw/stripe-korea-payment-methods-2025.md:38-117,142-152; raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:50-129,154-164).

May capture's local processor/no-local-entity model, redirect authorization stage, four-day post-approval funds availability and US/non-US payout schedule remain corroborated (raw/stripe-korea-payment-methods-2025.md:6-17,60-64,140; raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:7-17,72-76,152).

Old locally downloaded payment-flow asset at raw/stripe-korea-payment-methods-2025.md:14-17 is replaced by a remote video URL raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:15-17; this is a presentation asset difference and no proof the behavior changed.

Both dates state consumer refund, dispute and subscription notice boundaries (raw/stripe-korea-payment-methods-2025.md:160-203; raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:172-214); retain conditional/dated source wording and separate advice from requirements.

Both dates tell front-end merchants to enable South Korean payment methods in Dashboard before automatic display (old raw lines 119-136; new raw lines 131-148) and to obtain customer consent as well as notice at least 30 days before specified subscription charge changes (old raw line 197; new raw line 208).
conflicts: No material old-versus-new payment behavior conflict appears in tracking/collections/stripe/recollection-2026-11-07-en/pages/3cad5616010fd1013c7d2204/content.diff:1-90. Scope legal claims to the capture wording.

The source wiki/sources/source-stripe-korea-payment-methods.md:29 and concept wiki/concepts/stripe-korea-payment-methods.md:37 say merchant gets full amount upfront for installments; raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:170 refers to issuer installment funding, while raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:152 and :72-76 give Stripe balance and payout timing. Do not infer immediate external merchant settlement.

The concept wiki/concepts/stripe-korea-payment-methods.md:50 calls easy cancellation required while raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:210 recommends it to minimize disputes; legal compliance is urged elsewhere, but this page alone does not label a cancellation button mandatory.

Existing source-stripe-korea-payment-methods.md line 30 and concept wiki/concepts/stripe-korea-payment-methods.md lines 48-49 omit mandatory 30-day customer consent before subscription price increases or formerly free charges; both old raw line 197 and new raw line 208 require notice and consent. This is a baseline summary omission, not a November change.
unresolved_questions: The preview registration block raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:19-29 does not state enrollment criteria, rollout date, codes/schema, or whether any account has preview access; no registration was performed.

The page does not name Stripe's precise legal role versus its processor partner (raw/stripe-payments-countries-korea-2026-11-07.md:9); separate legal authority would be needed to conclude a merchant-of-record allocation.

Links to individual methods and pricing/tax/redirect guides are navigation only within this pinned overview; per-method API parameters or current eligibility are not established by following none of those links.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/countries/korea, the November guide continues to describe KRW local cards and wallets through Stripe and a local processor partner without requiring a South Korean entity. Front-end merchants enable the methods in Dashboard before Stripe automatically selects relevant ones; Checkout/Elements and API routes remain separate. Customers then authenticate after provider/processor redirect, payment approval precedes four-day Stripe-balance availability, and external payout timing is T+4 for US or T+7 elsewhere. Local cards, Kakao Pay and Naver Pay support recurring payments, whereas Samsung Pay and PAYCO are one-time only; Kakao Pay is unavailable in Singapore. Subscription merchants must both notify and obtain customer consent at least 30 days before a price increase or first charge for a previously free service, then remind customers seven days before payment. Old raw lines 119-140 and 195-203 already contain these prerequisites; new raw lines 131-164 and 206-214 repeat them. source-stripe-korea-payment-methods.md lines 13-30 omits Dashboard enablement and customer consent while preserving the core method and timing summary.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/countries/korea, the substantive November addition is only an optional registration to express interest in more descriptive decline codes (new raw lines 19-29); it does not grant preview access or enable payment methods. Changed video URL, table formatting, and Elements quickstart link are presentation/navigation. Old raw lines 119-140 and 195-203 already required Dashboard enablement for automatic front-end display and both 30-day customer notice AND consent for specified subscription charge changes, with a seven-day reminder; new raw lines 131-148 and 206-214 retain those obligations. source-stripe-korea-payment-methods.md omits enablement and consent, a baseline summary correction distinct from the preview. Its legal-role inference, conditional refund wording and issuer-installment versus Stripe-payout stages also need qualification. A redirect, preview registration or Dashboard setting alone proves neither payment approval nor live method eligibility; easy cancellation is advised, while a checkbox is illustrative best practice.
